title: Fairistry
description: A resource pack for forestry that retextures bees into fairies.
body:
Changes the bees, some UI and wording in forestry to be about fairies instead.
For now its very basic and they still live in hives and produce combs and honey but i might get around to retheming all that too.

This was made for my playthough of GTNH but I thought it would be fun to upload
